sonnet.problem: The opening card says Jesus fed the four thousand with 'seven loaves'. That gives away the right answer to the later fill-in-the-blank on card 16, where the answer is 'loaves'.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The right answer, that they did not bring any bread, repeats the fact card 11 already answered (the disciples forgot the bread). The baker can pick it from card 11, so the card tests nothing new.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
